newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujitsu and other global blue chips up on weak yen.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu and other global blue chips up on weak yen.

text.p: Shares of global blue-chip issues were higher on Wednesday morning on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, due to favourable factors including the yen's weakness, traders said.
Fujitsu Ltd shares were up 10 yen at 1,330 by 0137 GMT, hitting a high for the calendar year.
Its previous high was 1,320 yen marked last week.

Other global blue-chip shares, such as Toyota Motor Corp, Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd, Canon Inc, Takeda Chemical Industries Ltd, Sony Corp and Fuji Photo Film Co Ltd, also marked calendar-year highs on Wednesday morning.

"There is a favourable trading environment due to diminishing concern over inflation in the United States, rising stock prices in New York and the appropriate weakness of the yen. Because of this, traders started hunting for global blue-chip issues again," an official at a second-tier brokerage said.
"The trend is expected to grow as these companies are expected to post good business results in the coming earnings season," he added.
